# DevFlow Authoring

Use `AGENTS.md` for startup, `skills/devflow-core/SKILL.md` for lifecycle routing, and the selected owner reference for detailed rules. Core applies its risk gate: clear local reversible existing-feature changes with one plausible path, no security/data-loss/permission/contract risk, and quick proof may enter Cut directly; ambiguous or materially risky creative work enters Brainstorm. After the user selects A/B/C, named success edges are direct and non-unique artifacts return to Core. Preserve explicit STOP gates, selective learning recall, Cut, and Prove before completion.

When changing a host adapter, keep only host capability, owner lookup, fallback or load action, and proof exit. Do not copy lifecycle internals into every entry. Validate with the narrowest relevant package command.
